composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Show Toge Inumaki in a relaxed everyday scarf worn loosely below the chin, revealing his youthful face and familiar small cheek markings. His pale hair falls in soft short sections rather than a perfect helmet. He raises an open palm at the bottom side of the composition as a quiet hello, keeping the fingers away from his eyes. Use clean cel shading with pale lilac and warm ivory background shapes. Give him a restrained friendly smile and comfortable posture. Keep the framing close enough for his face to lead, with the scarf folds serving as simple supporting forms. Both visible irises contain a clear red Sharingan design with three small black comma marks and a normal dark pupil; keep bright catchlights and the friendly expression. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
